en.title: Pelagic and Demersal Species Groups
en.description:
This function lists the ISSCAAP species groups of marine fishes and crustaceans, and how each
is counted by the two definitions of `pelagic_demersal()`: "pelagic", "demersal" or "not
counted". ISSCAAP groups not listed (molluscs, diadromous and freshwater fishes, mammals,
plants, other invertebrates) are not counted by either definition.
en.value:
A data frame with one row per group: `isscaap_code`, `isscaap_en` (the name used in
the FAO data), `de_leiva_moreno` and `grainger_garcia`.

zh.title: 中上层与底层物种类群
zh.description: 本函数列出海洋鱼类和甲壳类的ISSCAAP物种类群，以及`pelagic_demersal()`的两种定义对每个类群的计法："pelagic"（中上层）、"demersal"（底层）或"not counted"（不计入）。未列出的ISSCAAP类群（软体动物、洄游性鱼类和淡水鱼类、哺乳动物、植物、其他无脊椎动物）在两种定义中都不计入。
zh.value: 一个数据框，每个类群一行：`isscaap_code`、`isscaap_en`（FAO数据中使用的名称）、`de_leiva_moreno`和`grainger_garcia`。
